description: This file implements a TCP socket server class 'SocketServer' with methods for opening a socket, accepting connections, sending and receiving messages, and managing the server thread. It defines message headers, handles client connections, and processes responses, primarily for a socket-based communication protocol. It also includes class 'Response' for encapsulating response data.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a response message with a channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: A class implementing a TCP socket server with methods to manage connections, send/receive messages, and handle threading.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes and binds a socket to a specified address and port, setting socket options, and preparing to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Creates a thread to run the server's main loop.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main server loop that accepts client connections and reads responses, invoking a callback for each response.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the server and client sockets, stopping the server.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the client socket, handling partial reads.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with headers, token, and JSON payload to the client.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach command with a channel ID and attach flag.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to the client and stops the server.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response header and payload from the client, populating a Response object.
